title: Income Assistance Act
source_id: R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.S-10 (duplicated for Nunavut; renamed from the Social Assistance Act by S.Nu. 2017, c.10)
verified_how: Register page 'INCOME ASSISTANCE ACT, Consolidation of', listed under I in the Current Consolidated Statutes and Regulations. The consolidation PDF's cover prints 'CONSOLIDATION OF INCOME ASSISTANCE ACT / R.S.N.W.T. 1988,c.S-10 / (Current to: July 11, 2019)', then 'AS AMENDED BY NORTWEST TERRITORIES STATUTES' (sic, the register's own spelling) and 'AS AMENDED BY NUNAVUT STATUTES', including S.Nu. 2017,c.10 'In force March 14, 2017, except s.8(c) / s.8(c) in force December 6, 2018: SI-009-2018'. In force; not repealed. Currency caveat printed on the Act's page: 'This consolidation is not up to date. See subsequent amendments: S.Nu. 2020,c.15,s.142(1) and 142(28).'
notes: Carried-over NWT statute: this is the Northwest Territories Social Assistance Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.S-10, duplicated for Nunavut under the Nunavut Act on April 1, 1999, and renamed the Income Assistance Act by Nunavut's own S.Nu. 2017, c.10. It still carries its NWT chapter citation because it has not yet been given a C.S.Nu. chapter number, and the register publishes it only as an unofficial 'Consolidation of', not an 'Official Consolidation of'. Unemployment benefits are federal (Employment Insurance Act, S.C. 1996, c. 23), as are the Canada Child Benefit and GST credit. Nunavut also has a Senior Citizens Benefits Act and a Collaboration for Poverty Reduction Act on the same register.
